description: Rotation plan for production secrets. Mirrors the schedule in docs/runbooks/secrets-rotation.md and the contract in src/lib/secrets/catalog.ts. Values are never stored here — only variable names, ages, and step descriptions.

steps.title: Generate a value of at least 32 characters (openssl rand -base64 48) in the store
Copy current SESSION_SECRET to SESSION_SECRET_PREVIOUS, then set SESSION_SECRET to the new value
Deploy the app so the new pair is live
Confirm current=ok previous=ok and that an existing session still works
After the session lifetime (7 days) plus one deploy, remove SESSION_SECRET_PREVIOUS
Confirm previous=not set
Generate a value of at least 32 characters
Set EDGE_HMAC_SECRET_PREVIOUS to the old value and EDGE_HMAC_SECRET to the new value on the origin; deploy origin first
Update the edge signer to sign with the new value
Verify one real request through the edge; old-signer requests must still verify
After edge rollout completes, remove EDGE_HMAC_SECRET_PREVIOUS and confirm unsigned requests still get 401
Confirm previous=not set
Generate a value of at least 32 characters
Move WORKER_SECRET to WORKER_SECRET_PREVIOUS and set the new value in prod:/app and prod:/worker
Deploy worker and app; run one queued job end to end
Confirm current=ok previous=ok
After the overlap window, remove WORKER_SECRET_PREVIOUS from both paths
Confirm previous=not set
In Backblaze, create a second application key scoped to the project bucket only
Set B2_KEY_ID_PREVIOUS/B2_APPLICATION_KEY_PREVIOUS to the old pair and B2_KEY_ID/B2_APPLICATION_KEY to the new pair
Deploy the app and worker
Upload a small file and download it through the app; check worker sync log for a 401 recovered on the previous key
Revoke the old application key in Backblaze
Remove the _PREVIOUS values from the store; repeat upload/download — a revoked key must not be needed
Create a new sending key in Resend (sending permission only)
Set RESEND_API_KEY to the new value in the store
Deploy the app
Send a password-reset or verification email and confirm delivery in Resend
Revoke the old key; keep store version history per retention policy
Create a new key in the provider console, scoped to the production project
Set LLM_API_KEY (and LLM_BASE_URL/LLM_MODEL if they changed) in the store
Deploy the app and worker
Run one agent or automation completion and check the provider dashboard for the new key
Revoke the old key
Create spindle_app_next with the same grants as spindle_app
Build new pooled and direct URLs with the new role/password; set DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_URL in prod:/app and prod:/deploy
Deploy; run npm run db:deploy and one read/write smoke test
Watch the connection count on the old role until it reaches zero
Drop the old role, revoke its password, and remove the old values from the store
